Great question! 🌿

No, the longer guarantee only applies to plants you order **while your Leafy Plus membership is active**. Plants you bought before joining stay on the standard **30-day guarantee**, counted from their delivery date.

If one of those earlier plants is still within its 30 days, you can make a claim from "My Orders" with at least two photos (whole plant and a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist reviews it within 2 business days.

I also need to correct something from my earlier message: the free change-of-mind returns with Leafy Plus apply to the **$6.95 return fee** on eligible non-living items. Live plants can't be returned for change of mind, whether or not you're a member.

Is there anything else I can help you with? Happy planting! 🌱
